answer: Random synchronous liveness checkpoints. Each epoch, an unpredictable fraction of identities is summoned to answer a fresh context-bound prompt tied to live ledger state — a seed like wander, violet, umber today differs entirely tomorrow, so nothing can be precomputed. A scripted farm cannot improvise coherent answers across dozens of identities in a tight window, so the operator must choose which survive each round. A miss suspends emission; repeat misses degrade standing. The attack's cheap resource, unattended automation, becomes demand for its scarce one: real simultaneous attention.
